items.title: Run live jailbreak probes in LLM mode before production agent launch

tactical: Immediately implement and execute the LLM live jailbreak probes in a staging or sandboxed environment before deploying the production agent. This rapid validation cycle mitigates critical pre-launch risks associated with prompt injection and bypassing safety guardrails. Prioritize running probes covering all known adversarial vectors to ensure the model’s resilience under immediate operational conditions.
strategic: Establish a permanent DevSecOps pipeline integrated with red-teaming and adversarial ML testing for all agentic applications. Future architecture must include comprehensive input and output validation layers, treating the LLM layer as a high-risk component requiring continuous security review and testing against evolving attack surfaces.
quick_wins: Run the LLM live jailbreak probes in a non-production environment immediately.
Implement robust input sanitation and output validation checks on the agent API.
Develop a threat modeling exercise focused specifically on adversarial attacks against the LLM prompts.
Define and enforce a mandatory security gate that requires passing all defined jailbreak tests before deployment.
